title: Still Water
description: One night in a drowned cypress swamp. Something long and pale lives in the black water, and it is blind: on the mud and the boardwalks you make no sound it can follow, but every step you wade carries, and every stroke you swim carries further. Search the Fishing Camp, the Stilt Village, the Drowned Chapel, the Watchtower, the Sunken Barge, the Pumphouse and the Boathouse for spring coils and the parts of a bazooka, build them at the workbench, then call it up with a rubber duck, the chapel bell or the generator and shoot it while its head is out of the water. It only has to find you once.

steps.title: It cannot see you
steps.body: Most of the swamp is black water, and something lives in it. It is blind. On land and boardwalks you are silent; every step you wade carries, and swimming carries furthest.

steps.title: Two thumbs
steps.body: Left thumb walks: push it only a little to wade slowly and quietly. Right thumb looks. Walk into a low bank or a ladder to climb out of the water.

steps.title: Find, then build
steps.body: Five spring coils make jump boots; five parts make a bazooka. The compass marks the places you have found, and the map button shows where you have been.

steps.title: Call it up
steps.body: Hold DUCK to aim and let go to throw. A duck in the water, the chapel bell or the pumphouse generator will bring it. When its head rears out of the water, fire.

hearing_range.label: How far it hears a wading step (m)
